Name: (RETIRED) Void's shovel retexture
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
[b][size=3][u]INFORMATION[/u]: [i]This mod does NOT works in 1.6(as shovel mod is not updated to 1.6). It will not be updated further.[/i][/size][/b]

This is a simple tetexture of the shovel from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15559?tab=description]Atravita's Growable Giant Crops[/url]﻿ so it fits all the upgrading stages of the other tools in vanilla, plus an extra weird version fitting to my weird craftables and stuff because I felt like it. I might do more retextures to other tool retexture mods if people want me to but for now that's all.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.
